Profit and Loss Statement (Actual vs Budget)

The Profit and Loss Statement Actual vs Budget form configures budget comparison reports.

Set parameters to compare actual income and expenses against budgeted amounts.

Title

The title that will appear at the top of the report. Leave blank to use the default title.

From

The starting date for the comparison period. Both actual and budget figures will be calculated from this date.

To

The ending date for the comparison period. Both actual and budget figures will be calculated up to this date.

Accounting method

Choose whether to use accrual basis or cash basis accounting for calculating actual amounts. This should match your regular accounting method.

Division

Optional division to filter the report. If selected, only transactions and budgets for this division will be included.

Lines

Enter budget amounts for each account. The report will compare these budgeted amounts against actual results.

Footer

Optional footer text that appears at the bottom of the report. Use this for notes about budget assumptions or variance explanations.

Exclude zero balances

Check this box to hide accounts where both actual and budget amounts are zero, making the report more concise.

Round decimals

Check this box to round amounts to whole numbers, removing decimal places for a cleaner presentation.
